name: ZENTAVA OIMS
description: An office information management platform for transparent administration and accountability, provided and operated by Kayron as a multi-tenant service. Load-tested with 60 organisations and 16,000 beneficiaries, with encrypted nightly off-site backups.

name: MINDI Hotel Management System
description: A hotel operations platform covering reservations and front desk, guest CRM, events and conferences, housekeeping, billing with Ghana taxes, restaurant and bar, inventory, staff rotas and reports. Offered as a subscription service with a free trial, in English and French, and installs as an app on phones and computers.

name: AVIEL Accounting
description: Double-entry accounting, invoicing, payroll and Mobile Money in the browser. Country presets set the currency, tax codes and payroll rules for more than 25 countries, with Ghana PAYE and SSNIT built in. Runs as an online subscription service, on a phone, or on a single shop computer.

name: NESTORA Rental Marketplace
description: A rental property marketplace and management platform launching in Ghana. Tenants, landlords, agents and companies each get their own dashboard, every listing shows the full move-in cost, and the platform handles verification, enquiries, inspections, tenancies and payment records.

name: AYRON Hospital Management Information System
description: A modular hospital information system for one or many facilities: patient records, OPD and consultations, admissions, pharmacy, laboratory, radiology, emergency, theatre, maternity, billing and insurance claims, with role-based access and a full audit trail.

name: KENDRA School Management
description: A subscription school management platform where many schools share one installation, each with its own separate database. Schools sign up with a free trial and choose a plan priced by number of pupils.

name: HOLIDO Website & Content Management
description: Website and content management system for Holistic Development Organisation (HOLIDO) in Tamale: programmes, projects, impact stories, news, resources and donations, with a private document library, draft and publish, revision history and automatic daily backups.

name: His Grace Academy Management System
description: School management system for His Grace Academy, Saboba: admissions, student records, fees and Mobile Money payments, attendance, report cards and transcripts, payroll, SMS and email messaging, and a parent and student portal.

name: Kings Gate International School
description:
Kayron Global Tech Services designed and developed a customized School Management System for Kings Gate International School.

The solution supports the management of student information, staff records and essential school administration activities through a centralized digital platform.

The project demonstrates our commitment to developing practical, user-friendly and scalable software solutions for educational institutions.

name: Fr. Joseph Connolly SVD Memorial School System
description: School management system for Fr. Joseph Connolly SVD Memorial School, Saboba: student records, fees and arrears, attendance and absence alerts, report cards, timetables, staff leave and payslips, with a portal for parents and students.

name: Divine Destiny Clinic Management System
description: Clinic management system for a private hospital in Ghana: patient registration, appointments, OPD encounters, wards and beds, admissions, invoicing and reports. Runs on one clinic computer and serves other devices on the clinic network, with automatic daily backups.

name: NCRI-Ghana
description: Website for the Northern Community Resilience Initiative (NCRI-Ghana), a development organisation in Saboba, Northern Region, working with women, girls, young people and vulnerable households. The site presents the organisation's six programme pillars: child protection and education, women and girls, agriculture and rural livelihoods, youth, climate and community resilience, and water, sanitation and hygiene. It includes the organisation's vision, mission and values, photo stories for each area of work, impact figures and learning, links to the UN Sustainable Development Goals, a gallery and news, and clear routes to partner, volunteer, donate or get in touch.
